'''Vinsoth''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] and [[Chev]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was a temperate planet with zones of [[Grass/Legends|grasslands]] and prairies, arctic [[Water/Legends|ice]], and [[Desert/Legends|deserts]].

==Description==
[[File:Chevin_FH.png|thumb|left|A [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]].]]

The Chevin had a skin that could adapt to all three environments. In [[3,000,000 BBY]], an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] collided with the planet, killing most life on its surface, but the remaining survivors evolved into the Chevin. The Chevin were nomadic pastoralists, following herds of the native grazing [[backshin]] and keeping their Chev [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] in small [[Farm/Legends|farming]] and manufacturing villages. The planet was composed of seven continents, each ruled by a Chevin dictator who remained stationary, while the rest of the Chevin migrated.

==History==
During the [[Third Galactic War]], Vinsoth was the site of a [[Attack on Vinsoth|major battle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Into the Shadow">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Into the Shadows|[[Khar Shian]]}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Vinsoth was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="TEA" />

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Ephant Mon/Legends|Ephant Mon]] established a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-cult [[Force-cult temple|Temple]] on the planet and advocated Chev liberation.<ref name="WBO" /> During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Vinsoth was [[Battle of Vinsoth|conquered]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong|invaders]] at the beginning of the conflict.<ref name="TEA" />
After the Yuuzhan Vong War, many Chevins favored abolishing slavery and joining the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. However, they had to form secret societies, as they were persecuted as traitors by the local dictators, who sent [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] after them.

During the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], Vinsoth was contained within the boundaries of the [[Fel Empire]]. During the war, however, Vinsoth was [[Fall of Vinsoth|lost]] to [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].<ref name="LW2" />
